name: fast-compact
description: /fast-compact (and /fc): cut old tool output to its start and end in about a second, with Jev keeping whole what is still needed and every cut saved to a file. Claude Code's own /compact is untouched.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: openrouter (default; key in OPENROUTER_API_KEY) or typesafe (key in TYPESAFE_API_KEY).

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Key for the provider. Leave unset to use OPENROUTER_API_KEY or TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment or settings.

baseUrl.title: Endpoint override
baseUrl.description: A System One endpoint other than the provider's own. Leave unset.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model name sent with each request.

keepRecentCalls.title: Recent tool calls kept as they are
keepRecentCalls.description: The newest tool calls whose inputs and outputs are never cut.

cutTo.title: Characters a cut keeps
cutTo.description: A cut output or input keeps this many characters: two thirds from its start, one third from its end.

keepWhole.title: Share Jev may keep whole
keepWhole.description: At most this share of the old outputs' characters stays whole on Jev's ranking (0 to 1).

minKeepScore.title: Least Jev score to keep whole
minKeepScore.description: An output Jev rates below this is never kept whole (0 to 1).

cutInputs.title: Cut long tool inputs too
cutInputs.description: Cut long old tool inputs (Bash scripts, Write bodies, Edit strings) the same way.

sendSamples.title: Show Jev output samples
sendSamples.description: Send Jev the first 200 and last 100 characters of each output it ranks.

resumeSafe.title: Keep the compaction across --resume
resumeSafe.description: Hand messages back as new ones, so a resumed session loads the compacted history (older messages lose hidden reasoning and images; text and tool calls stay).

autoCompact.title: Cut instead of summarising on auto-compaction
autoCompact.description: When Claude Code compacts on its own, cut old tool output the way /fc does if that frees at least a fifth of the conversation; otherwise Claude Code summarises as usual.

meter.title: Show what /fc would free
meter.description: off (default), prompt (a line under the prompt after each turn) or statusline (the token count in ~/.claude/fast-compact/meter/<session id>, for your status line).
